note: The Rift finale's two fights, Captain Brann Saye and Director Elara Venn. Since the integration of 2026-10-04 (the integrating session's call on the owner's 'FINISH THE FINALE ... the confrontation with Elara and Brann'): ONE Brann and ONE Elara, each a single Cobblemon NPC in their HQ tower room (data/hq_tower.json npcs: Codex's placement) who both TALKS (their conversations and stage transitions, data/dialogue.json dlg_main_finale_brann / _elara) and FIGHTS through Cobblemon's own NPC battle: the conversation's npc_battle names this file's `team`, which tools/compile_dialogue.py compiles into the NPC class's `simple` party, a choice starts q.npc.start_battle(q.player, 'singles'), and the cobblers_hq_tower pack's battle_victory callback (tools/hq_tower.py) runs `sets` as the winning player. This file is therefore TEAMS ONLY: tools/route_trainers.py does not read it, rctmod places nothing from it.
departures_from_the_finale_doc: Codex's doc has no battles and no teams: its Brann stands down ('My people will not fight a trainer who came through eight leaders to stop that') and its Elara opens the shaft after a conversation. The owner asked for a confrontation with both, so both fight: Brann's line 4 gains 'I will.' and his stand-down follows the win; Elara's lines 1-4 open her battle and 5-7 follow it.

Codex's intermediate stages ARE in the enum (data/progression.json, the HQ tower's unit): the fights sit inside them, Brann's before hq_crossed and Elara's before cradle_open (data/hq_tower.json finale_order).
level_cap: 60 after gym 8 (docs/mechanics/LEAGUE_LEVEL_CAP.md: 'After gym 8 the cap stays at 60'). Brann tops out at 58 (Victory Road's veterans reach 59-60); Elara's ace is 60, level with the cap and with every Elite Four ace (data/trainers.json elite_01..04), because she is the story's last fight before the League.
teams_why: authored here, not in the finale doc (it has none): for trainer-balance-designer to review. Sets reuse the repository's own authored sets where the species already has one (Hariyama from Bruno, Aggron and Excadrill from Victory Road, Arcanine from Blaine, Bronzong and Hatterene from Sabrina; Klinklang's Victory Road set with Wild Charge for Charge Beam), re-levelled, with an ability, item and nature where the source set had none. Corviknight, Porygon-Z, Reuniclus and Metagross are new sets of level-up or TM moves; their legality against the Cobblemon 1.8.0 jar is NOT checked (no legality tool exists; the same open item as data/arena_fights.json mechanism_needs N11). Brann: the guard captain, a wall of Steel and Fighting. Elara: the Compact's machine and its binding, Steel and Psychic, Trick Room behind a Bronzong, Metagross the ace.

dialogue_text.pre: Nia sent you. Every person below us has watched a home fail, and I will not call them villains for wanting one place that stays. Show me you can stop this without killing the city.
dialogue_text.player_win: I read Tomas's result. The destination is occupied, and Elara ordered the cycle anyway. I am standing the cradle guard down. Do not mistake that for forgiveness.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Go back up. A reckless shutdown kills this city, and you are not ready to make a careful one.

dialogue_text.pre: Listen to the city before you call this simple. I knew the destination was occupied. I ordered the cycle because I could name the people who would die if I stopped.
dialogue_text.player_win: That certainty became an excuse to leave the other names blank. There is no operation left to finish. Release it, and we begin the work that cannot be solved by exchanging somebody else's home.
dialogue_text.player_loss: Every light below us belongs to someone the Compact carried out. Do not come back to put them out.

moved_why: Two of each character collided when the cradle confrontation (commits 3e0f5ad, d968d79: rctmod trainers seated in Hoopa's cradle) met the HQ tower (7e0524e, da3ceba: Cobblemon dialogue NPCs in their rooms, with Codex's four intermediate stages). The rctmod seats were dropped, not the NPCs, because (1) Codex places Brann in the briefing hall and Elara in the director's office, and their stage transitions (hq_crossed, cradle_open) are spoken there; (2) a Cobblemon NPC with a party fights through the mechanism proven in game on 2026-10-03 for the arena (docs/research/notes/arena-per-player-opponents.md section 8: start_battle opened the battle, the battle_victory callback saw the win and the loss), so one entity can carry both; (3) an rctmod trainer cannot open our compiled dialogue. Each record's cradle seat, sight, skin, rctmod lines and rct block are kept under superseded_seat: the seats were measured off the cradle's own cells, and if the owner wants the fights back in the cradle that is the work to restore.
